title: A request that names no model gets the default its kind declares
intention: A resolve request that names no model gets the default declared for its kind in the route stacks data; a kind with no declared default is refused by name before any host is dialed. The code picks no model.
why: Measured 2026-10-14: a bus generate request naming no model was sent to nomic-embed-text and refused as if the route had failed, so the asker is told the wrong cause. The default was a code literal valid for one kind only, and nomic's duty is embed only (Akien 2026-08-08).
traces_to: Law 7 (an error names its real cause at the diagnostic surface) and Law 4 (a rule that matters lives in data or physics, not a literal one kind happened to fit).
how: A Haiku builder needs: (a) the place: _handle_resolve in cairn/devices/inference_domain/device.py:113; replace the literal default with a lookup of the request's kind in a declared defaults table; (b) the data: add a 'kind_defaults' object (e.g. {'embed': 'nomic-embed-text'}) to cairn/devices/inference_domain/machines/route/stacks/models.json or a sibling defaults.json in that dir, read through whatever loader route.py already uses for stacks; (c) validate at load that each default's model 'serves' lists that kind; (d) refusal for a missing default is a returned error body the shim replies with (the device's existing refusal shape), raised before host.ollama_resolver is built; (e) proof at cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_a_request_naming_no_model_gets_its_kind_default.py, teeth 1-5, fixture stacks with no network (tooth 2 must show no dial: use a transport that fails the test if called); (f) bind subjects at call time inside the runner.
falsifier: RED if after the build: (1) an embed request naming no model resolves with nomic-embed-text, read from the stacks data, not a code literal (grep device.py for the literal 'nomic-embed-text' finds none); (2) a generate/chat request naming no model is refused before any host is dialed, the refusal naming the missing model, the request's kind, and the kinds that declare a default; (3) a request naming a model is unchanged (model passes through); (4) the declared defaults are validated: a default naming a model whose 'serves' does not include that kind is refused at load; (5) the existing inference_domain proofs stay green. Wrong-intent signal: a no-model generate request is answered by any model the code picked.
watchme: none, because the regression event is every resolve through cairn/devices/inference_domain/device.py, and its refusals already land in the inference call log read by cairn inference_domain calls
children: none, because it is one lookup in cairn/devices/inference_domain/device.py plus one data table beside the route stacks
intent_berth: none, because a bug enters at TICKET (skills/intent/SKILL.md); the measurement is BUILDER's at cairn/devices/inference_domain/device.py:113, 2026-10-14

decisions.text: D1 (the /sorted builder_check): A Haiku builder needs: (a) the place: _handle_resolve in cairn/devices/inference_domain/device.py:113; replace the literal default with a lookup of the request's kind in a declared defaults table; (b) the data: add a 'kind_defaults' object (e.g. {'embed': 'nomic-embed-text'}) to cairn/devices/inference_domain/machines/route/stacks/models.json or a sibling defaults.json in that dir, read through whatever loader route.py already uses for stacks; (c) validate at load that each default's model 'serves' lists that kind; (d) refusal for a missing default is a returned error body the shim replies with (the device's existing refusal shape), raised before host.ollama_resolver is built; (e) proof at cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_a_request_naming_no_model_gets_its_kind_default.py, teeth 1-5, fixture stacks with no network (tooth 2 must show no dial: use a transport that fails the test if called); (f) bind subjects at call time inside the runner.

test_task_ticket.py's bus-refusal tooth posted a model-less generate and leaned on the old embed default to reach the host; it now names qwen2.5:7b. Instrument repaired to current names, same claim measured (a host refusal over the bus returns a ticket naming its caller). CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-12 'approved thru PROVED, fastest route'.

kind_defaults is a top-level key of machines/route/stacks/models.json, a flat object kind->model name ({"embed": "nomic-embed-text"}); load_stacks validates it and route.kind_default(kind) reads it. The refusal reuses _handle_resolve's existing refusal dict {outcome:'refused', refused:<exc type>, detail, ticket:None, model:None, hit:False, answer:None}. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-12 'approved thru PROVED, fastest route'.

'Bind subjects at call time' means the proof imports device, route and load_stacks inside each tooth (never at module level) and patches host.ollama_resolver and domain.resolve inside the call, so the hollow reading can revert the build. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-12 'approved thru PROVED, fastest route'.

The ticket's model field (opus) is the builder; D1's 'a Haiku builder needs' means the decisions are written so even a Haiku reader could build from them, not that Haiku runs the build. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-12 'approved thru PROVED, fastest route'.

The tooth is test_a_refusal_raises_a_trouble_naming_the_ticket_and_the_shim_returns_a_value (test_task_ticket.py:226). Its claim is unchanged: the HOST refuses (a patched resolver raising _Unreachable) and the shim returns that refusal with a ticket. The only edit is adding "model": "qwen2.5:7b" to its request body so it reaches the host instead of the new no-default refusal; it does not test the no-default refusal (959b's own proof does). CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-12 'approved thru PROVED, fastest route'.

The proof is already written and on disk: cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_a_request_naming_no_model_gets_its_kind_default.py (five teeth, fixture stacks copied into a tmpdir, resolver and domain patched, no network). Tooth 4 requires only that RouteRefused names the kind and the model. The builder runs it; it does not rewrite it. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-12 'approved thru PROVED, fastest route'.
